facts.name: Pennsylvania Sedge
facts.light: Part shade to shade; handles dry shade under trees
facts.notes: A fine, soft groundcover that knits the bed together, fills gaps and crowds out weeds. Rarely needs mowing or trimming.

companions.why: Heuchera 'Brownies' gives a bolder contrast to the sedge's fine leaves at a woodland edge.
New Moon Nurseries: in lightly shaded gardens, companions include wild columbine, Pennsylvania sedge and lanceleaf coreopsis.
